summary: v2 improves the large mountain silhouettes, but all ten ridges fail as continuous pseudo-script centerlines with touching hatches, absent broad tonal bands, and residual side-face cues.
required_changes: Erase only the ten scripted line chains and use a revised control that explicitly shows three detached crest-fragment zones plus one detached hatch zone per ridge.
